words.defn_en: having made no legal will before death:
words.root_note: in- (not) + testari (to make a will), from Latin

sentences.en: He died ______ , leaving his heirs to settle the estate in court.
sentences.zh: 他未立遺囑就去世了,讓繼承人只能透過法院來處理遺產。

sentences.en: Dying ______ can lead to lengthy legal disputes among relatives.
sentences.zh: 未立遺囑死亡可能導致親屬之間漫長的法律糾紛。

words.defn_en: not willing to accept views or behavior different from one's own:

sentences.en: He grew increasingly ______ of dissenting opinions.
sentences.zh: 他變得越來越不能容忍不同的意見。

sentences.en: The community was praised for being ______ of discrimination.
sentences.zh: 這個社區因不容忍任何歧視而受到讚揚。

sentences.en: The problem proved ______, resisting every solution the team proposed.
sentences.zh: 這個問題難以解決,團隊提出的每個方案都行不通。

sentences.en: Negotiators faced an ______ opponent who refused every compromise.
sentences.zh: 談判人員面對的是一個拒絕任何妥協、難以駕馭的對手。

words.defn_en: refusing to compromise, often on an extreme opinion:

sentences.en: Negotiations stalled because both sides remained completely ______.
sentences.zh: 由於雙方都堅持不肯妥協,談判陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: Her ______ stance on the issue frustrated even her closest allies.
sentences.zh: 她在這個議題上不肯讓步的立場,讓連她最親近的盟友都感到沮喪。

sentences.en: The ______ explorer crossed the desert alone with only a small amount of water.
sentences.zh: 這位無畏的探險家僅帶著少量的水,獨自穿越了沙漠。

sentences.en: It took an ______ firefighter to run into the burning building to save the child.
sentences.zh: 需要一位無畏的消防員衝進燃燒的大樓才能救出那個孩子。

words.defn_en: not legally or officially valid; a person disabled by illness:

sentences.en: The contract was ruled ______ due to a missing signature.
sentences.zh: 由於缺少簽名,這份合約被裁定為無效。

sentences.en: The nurse cared for the elderly ______ every afternoon.
sentences.zh: 這位護理師每天下午都會照顧這位年老的病弱者。

words.defn_en: to deprive of legal force, cancel:abrogate\

sentences.en: A single typo on the form could ______ the entire application.
sentences.zh: 表格上一個小小的打字錯誤就可能使整份申請作廢。

sentences.en: The court moved to ______ the results of the disputed election.
sentences.zh: 法院採取行動宣布這場有爭議的選舉結果無效。

sentences.en: His morning routine remained ______ for over a decade.
sentences.zh: 他早晨的例行程序十多年來始終不變。

sentences.en: The recipe calls for an ______ ratio of flour to water.
sentences.zh: 這份食譜要求麵粉與水維持固定不變的比例。

sentences.en: The treaty declared the border ______ under international law.
sentences.zh: 這項條約宣告根據國際法,這條邊界是不可侵犯的。

sentences.en: She considered her promise to her mother an ______ vow.
sentences.zh: 她認為對母親的承諾是一個不可違背的誓言。

sentences.en: The virus is ______ to the naked eye.
sentences.zh: 這種病毒肉眼看不見。

sentences.en: She felt ______ in the large, impersonal office.
sentences.zh: 在這間龐大又冷漠的辦公室裡,她感覺自己彷彿隱形一般。

sentences.en: She ______ gasped in surprise.
sentences.zh: 她不由自主地驚訝倒抽了一口氣。

sentences.en: His hand ______ jerked back when he touched the hot stove.
sentences.zh: 當他碰到滾燙的爐子時,他的手不由自主地縮了回去。

sentences.en: His ______ fear of clowns kept him from attending the circus.
sentences.zh: 他對小丑不理性的恐懼讓他不敢去看馬戲團表演。

sentences.en: It's ______ to blame the weather for your bad mood all week.
sentences.zh: 把整週心情不好都怪罪於天氣是不理智的。

words.defn_en: unable to be reformed or recovered:
words.defn_zh: 無法挽回的;不可救藥的
words.root_note: in- (not) + reclamare (to cry out against), from Latin

sentences.en: The land was deemed ______ after years of pollution.
sentences.zh: 多年污染後,這片土地被認為已無法挽回。

sentences.en: Some critics considered him an ______ criminal.
sentences.zh: 有些評論家認為他是個不可救藥的罪犯。

words.defn_en: impossible to resolve or bring into harmony:
words.defn_zh: 無法調和的;不可協調的

sentences.en: The couple cited ______ differences in their divorce filing.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻在離婚申請書上引述了無法調和的差異。

sentences.en: The two political factions remained ______ for decades.
sentences.zh: 這兩個政治派系數十年來始終無法調和。

words.defn_en: not able to be saved, improved, or corrected:
words.defn_zh: 無可救藥的;不可挽回的
words.root_note: in- (not) + redimere (to buy back), from Latin

sentences.en: The critic called the film an ______ disaster.
sentences.zh: 這位評論家批評這部電影是一場無可救藥的災難。

sentences.en: He believed no soul was truly ______ .
sentences.zh: 他相信沒有任何靈魂是真正無可救藥的。

words.defn_en: not able to be reformed or changed for the better:

sentences.en: Critics argued the outdated system was ______ .
sentences.zh: 評論家主張這套過時的體系已無法改革。

sentences.en: The old policy proved ______ despite years of lobbying.
sentences.zh: 儘管多年遊說,這項舊政策仍被證實無法改革。

words.defn_en: not able to be refuted or disproved:

sentences.en: The scientist presented ______ proof of her theory.
sentences.zh: 這位科學家提出了她理論無可辯駁的證明。

sentences.en: His alibi was ______ , confirmed by multiple witnesses.
sentences.zh: 他的不在場證明無可辯駁,獲得多位證人的證實。

words.defn_en: not conforming to a standard or pattern:

sentences.en: The doctor noted an ______ heartbeat during the exam.
sentences.zh: 醫生在檢查時注意到心跳不規律。

sentences.en: Her sleeping schedule has been quite ______ this month.
sentences.zh: 她這個月的睡眠時間相當不規律。

sentences.en: The lawyer objected, arguing that the question was ______ to the case.
sentences.zh: 律師提出異議,主張這個問題與本案無關。

sentences.en: Please don't include ______ details that distract from the main point.
sentences.zh: 請不要加入與主旨無關、會分散注意力的細節。

words.defn_zh: 無可指責的;完美無瑕的

sentences.en: Her ______ conduct earned her the committee's respect.
sentences.zh: 她無可指責的行為舉止贏得了委員會的尊重。

sentences.en: The audit found his financial records ______ .
sentences.zh: 這次審計發現他的財務紀錄無可挑剔。

sentences.en: His ______ leadership left the team without clear direction.
sentences.zh: 他猶豫不決的領導讓團隊失去了明確的方向。

sentences.en: She stood ______ at the crossroads, unsure which path to take.
sentences.zh: 她站在十字路口猶豫不決,不知該走哪條路。

sentences.en: The comedian's ______ toward authority figures made his act controversial.
sentences.zh: 這位喜劇演員對權威人士的不敬態度讓他的表演飽受爭議。

sentences.en: Her ______ during the solemn ceremony shocked the other guests.
sentences.zh: 她在這場莊嚴儀式上的不敬舉止,讓其他賓客大為震驚。

words.defn_en: showing a lack of respect for things generally taken seriously:

sentences.en: The comedian's ______ jokes about politics drew both laughs and criticism.
sentences.zh: 這位喜劇演員對政治不敬的笑話引來了笑聲與批評。

sentences.en: Her ______ tone shocked the traditional audience.
sentences.zh: 她不敬的語氣震驚了這群傳統的觀眾。

words.defn_zh: 不可撤銷的/無法挽回的

sentences.en: Once signed, the contract becomes ______.
sentences.zh: 這份合約一旦簽署,便無法撤銷。

sentences.en: His decision to leave the company felt ______ and final.
sentences.zh: 他決定離開這家公司,這個決定顯得無法挽回且已成定局。

sentences.en: The side effects of the medication were ______.
sentences.zh: 這種藥物的副作用是非預期的。

sentences.en: His comment had the ______ effect of upsetting several colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他的評論意外地讓好幾位同事感到不悅。
